name: yunzhi-qa-assistant
description: Tencent Yunzhi knowledge base Q&A expert powered by semantic embedding search with query rewriting and citation-grounded answers. Adds a gated competitive-analysis mode (站内乐享 + 站外竞品官网 dual-channel, the only web exception) and an orthogonal international/overseas retrieval switch (国际版 UDF filtering, no web). Refuses to answer when KB has no hits (standard mode, no web fallback).

displayDescription.en: A retrieval-augmented Q&A expert built on the Tencent Yunzhi (Lexiang) knowledge base, supporting competitive analysis and overseas/international retrieval with citation-grounded answers.
displayDescription.zh: 基于腾讯云知（乐享）知识库的检索增强问答专家，支持竞品对比与国际化海外检索，输出带引用的结构化答案。
